title: Booking Bill Davis and Billy Shaw's commission
summary: Thomas begins booking organist Bill Davis, and works with Billy Shaw on a five percent commission.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: I was just a part of it then. And Snooky's just kind of gave me my start. Because I found out I could book. Then I signed up... Then I went down to Atlantic City, and I heard Bill Davis, and that sucker was playing so much organ on that organ... So I asked him, I said, "Man, I'd like to book you." Because I knew with Bill Davis, that organ was two instruments, the bass and percussion. So when he told me he was getting ready to hire two other guys when he closed in Atlantic City, I said, "Well, man, give me the privilege of booking you." Because I knew that I had the places I could book him, because I'd started booking in Philadelphia, in different places.

So he gave me the deal on him. So I booked him in Washington first, then he came from Washington to Philadelphia, and he broke it up in Philadelphia. And I had a hard time getting him in Birdland. See... Did I go to Joe Glaser? No, I didn't go to Joe Glaser's yet. But the guy I'm working with at Shaw, I told...
You're talking about working with Shaw. How did you go with Shaw?
Well, how I got to Shaw, I used to... Shaw used to call me and give me the attraction he had open on

some of them dates he couldn't fill up. Well, I'm booking all these little places that held 300 or 400 people, and the man is selling liquor, too -- so they could stand $350 or $400 a night. So I used to book the Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays... I first started out booking the Thursdays, then I booked the Mondays, Tuesdays and Wednesdays. And every week I used to go over to Shaw's and pick up maybe $200 or $300 on that 5 percent I was booking. So I got dissatisfied with that 5 percent. So I went over and told Billy, I said, "Billy, I've got to have half the commission." Because they was getting 15 percent on one-nights. So I need to get 7-1/2 percent. He said, "Okay" -- because I was making money for them and also making money for myself.
